full.title: Separate services
full.short: Every service has its own URL
full.help: Registries, discovery and repositories each have their own URL. You need an AAS repository or registry and a submodel repository or registry.

mono-repo.title: AAS environment with separate registries
mono-repo.short: One URL for the repositories, own URLs for registries and discovery
mono-repo.help: The AAS environment serves the repositories; registries and discovery run as separate services. Enables export and upload.

identifiable.help: Only an AAS repository; submodels are read through the shells that reference them.
